chapter_title: Concerning the Fourteen Vehicles that Jesus has bo
spiritual_reading:
The first means of progression is initial enlightenment in the outer mind, because there the Divine received directive truth from the mediating Divine influence.

The second means of progression is the ordered knowledges that support the combatting good, because within those general truths that good was given a stable foundation for its operation.

The third is the manifested Divine presence in its full human completeness, because in that fullness wisdom and love shone forth distinctly. From that fullness the Divine flowed down into lower degrees and made itself perceptible within the natural level.

The fourth is the interior call of Divine truth that the Divine took into full union with its assumed humanity. The fifth is the willing compliance of the human level that the Divine bound to that call, so that the lower degree might act from the higher.

The sixth is the living respiration of spiritual life; because the Divine also took this into union, it became consecrated by celestial love for use. The seventh is the living movement of that respiration as operative spiritual power. The eighth is the discernment that gives understanding. The ninth is living truth that purifies and teaches. The tenth is living love that is above them all and governs them.

In this full series of sufficient means, the Divine progressed through every arranged level of heaven and the church and through every community and state within them, in higher and in lower degrees.

fills.notes: The closing summary requires a comprehensive cosmological term parallel to “all the orders”: he journeys through the whole arranged heaven. In the oldest Iranian-substrate register, “orders” names ranked formations, while “aeons” names the great totalities or world-ages that contain those ranks. This matches the spiritual sense: progression through every arranged level of heaven and the church, in higher and lower degrees.

assessment: Only one gap. The correspondential structure (ten vehicles spanning degrees) constrains the missing noun to a totalizing cosmological category paired with “orders.” “Aeons” best fits the oldest-layer register and the intended sweep (above and below), though the exact Coptic equivalent cannot be proven from syntax alone.
